purpose: Recover exact TRAIN/DEV source payloads and token identities for the bound large review62 feature population, preparing a possible later encoder-adaptation experiment without persistent body caches.
sources: four original v9 TRAIN/DEV input inventories bound by semantic-features11
source_policy: Read only enumerated TRAIN/DEV files and original inventories; do not load reservedTEST, calibration or diagnostic data. Preserve all original IDs, partitions, payloads, gold fields and binary targets.
checks: Verify original inventories and generated TRAIN/DEV identities against their source reports.
Require exact one-to-one source coverage of feature62 metadata by language/case ID, matching labels, partition, source group and token identity.
Recreate model tokens using the pinned local tokenizer and public runtime classifier serialization; require hashes identical to the frozen feature metadata and original lengths where available.
Retain source payloads/tokens privately and publish only aggregate/hash evidence; no weights or fullencoder are loaded.
scope: Input recovery and compatibility only. It does not supply new meanings, establish data-label correctness or qualify a model.
